metadata.title: A Low-Frequency MEMS Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting System Based on Frequency Up-Conversion Mechanism

configuration.quote: PEHS consists of a high-frequency straight piezoelectric cantilever (SPC), a low-frequency S-shaped stainless-steel cantilever (SSC)

proof_mass.quote: At the free end of the SSC, two nickel proof masses were assembled

width_mm.quote: surface area of the SPC was 15 × 14 mm^2

thickness_mm.quote: The thickness of the cantilever was controlled using a DRIE process to about 275 μm

substrate_thickness_um.quote: Thickness of the Si substrate 200 μm

piezo_thickness_um.quote: Thickness of the PZT layer 65 μm

type.quote: mounted onto a TIRA vibration exciter
